# DomeLight + Ground
create_prim(prim_path="/World/DomeLight", prim_type="DomeLight")

create_prim(prim_path="/World/Ground", prim_type="Cube", position=[0, 0, -0.5], scale=[20, 20, 1])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Ground", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

# Table
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Table", prim_type="Cube", position=[0, 0, 0.375], scale=[1.5, 0.6, 0.375])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Table", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

set_physics_scene_config(config={"enable_gpu_dynamics": False, "broadphase_type": "MBP"})

# Franka
robot_wizard(
    robot_name="franka_panda",
    dest_path="/World/Franka",
    position=[0.0, 0, 0.75],
    orientation=[1.0, 0, 0, 0],
)

# Cube ON TABLE at +Y side (in reach)
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cube", prim_type="Cube", position=[-0.3, 0.3, 0.775], size=0.05)
for api in ("PhysicsRigidBodyAPI", "PhysicsCollisionAPI", "PhysicsMassAPI", "PhysxRigidBodyAPI"):
    apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube", schema_name=api)
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/Cube", attr_name="physics:mass", value=0.1)
apply_physics_material(prim_path="/World/Cube", material_name="rubber")

# TIGHT BIN at -Y side (in reach). Inner opening 5.5x5.5cm = 5mm tolerance per side.
# Bin 7cm outer / ~6cm inner = 5mm clearance per side for the 5cm cube (genuine precision bin / drop-precision forcing function).

# Controller — pick from cube position, drop to bin
setup_pick_place_controller(
    robot_path="/World/Franka",
    target_source="curobo",
    belt_path=None,

    drop_target=[0.265, -0.335, 0.83],
